notes.title: Nominate Blue Wednesday for the 2023 Steam Awards!
notes.content:
[h3]Nominate Blue Wednesday for the 2023 Steam Awards! [/h3]

Are you enjoying our game?

Enjoy your own jazz journey as you explore Evans City, meet new people and collect different albums along the way! Morris, a jazz pianist, has always been in a dark and depressed mood due to his constant failures, but by doing what he loves and meeting warm people, he finds his lost dreams. 

Steam Awards voting is now open. 
We hope you enjoy Blue Wednesday, with its great sound and story. 
Help us make it to the finalists this year.
Vote for your favourite 『 Blue Wednesday 』 as the best "Sit Back and Relax" game in the Steam Awards.

notes.title: Blue Wednesday is finally OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921327/60b9a4a9a76c3c815a4e4a3b142a1823e1e354ef.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, guys![/h2]

Thank you for your long wait. 
Blue Wednesday is now live.  


It's not a fancy, glamorous story.
We tried to express dreams, love, and failure through jazz - things we all go through, can go through, and have gone through. 

We hope you enjoy it and love it. 
And we want to say a big thank you (❤️) for your patience.  


We're constantly updating and improving, 
so if you find any inconveniences or bugs while playing, please report them. Thank you!

notes.title: Blue Wednesday Steam Next Fest demo is available as of now!!
notes.content:

[h3]
Blue Wednesday demo is live as of now~
[/h3]

Hey guys!
Everyone playing the demo here at Next Fest will have the honour to try our keyboard and controller.
It would be helpful if you could give us feedback on the controls and on our demo. 
We're very interested in what you think about the game. 
[b]Enjoy hidden albums and mini-games through conversations with Fernando![/b]

Any additional information, we're going to stream playthrough [u]on Wednesday(!!) at 10:00 pm (PST)[/u]
